{{nihongo|'''Inbe Shrine (Matsue City)'''|忌部神社 (松江市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izumo Province]].

'''Inbe Shrine''' (いんべじんじゃ) is a shrine in Higashi-Inbe-chō, {{ill|Matsue|Q207321|qid=Q207321}}, {{ill|Shimane Prefecture|Q132751|qid=Q132751}}. Until the end of Meiji, it was called Ōmiya Shrine.

=== Enshrined deities ===
Its main deity is {{ill|Futodama|it|Futodama|ja|フトダマ|ru|Футодама|simple|Futodama|zh|布刀玉命|qid=Q11059539|lt=Ame-no-Futodama-no-Mikoto}}. As associated deities, it enshrines {{ill|Amaterasu|Q455602|qid=Q455602|lt=Amaterasu Ōmikami}} (said to have been invited from {{ill|Hinomisaki Shrine|Q1619446|qid=Q1619446}}) and {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|Q2564508|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}} (said to have been invited from {{ill|Kasuga-taisha|ca|Gran santuari de Kasuga|co|Grandi Santuariu Kasuga|cs|Svatyně Kasuga|de|Kasuga-Taisha|es|Kasuga-taisha|eu|Kasuga-taisha|fa|کاسوگا-تایشا|fi|Kasuga-taisha|fr|Kasuga-taisha|he|מקדש קאסוגה|id|Kuil Agung Kasuga|it|Santuario Kasuga|ja|春日大社|ka|კასუგა-ტაისია|ko|가스가타이샤|la|Kasuga-taisha|pl|Kasuga Taisha|pt|Kasuga-taisha|ru|Касуга тайся|sh|Kasuga-taisha|simple|Kasuga Taisha|sl|Svetišče Kasuga|th|ศาลเจ้าคาซูงะ|tok|tomo sewi suli Kasuka|tr|Kasuga-taisha|uk|Касуга тайся|zh|春日大社|qid=Q714559}}), along with 22 other deities.

=== History ===
The area of the shrine’s location belonged to Inbe Kamube recorded in the Ōu District section of the ''{{ill|Izumo-no-Kuni Fudoki|Q11395858|qid=Q11395858}}''{{Sfn|Japanese Gods: Shrines and Sacred Places|p=27}}. According to old records preserved at this shrine, it was once called Sansha Ōmiya Daimyōjin and was the central shrine of the Inbe area, and from around the late {{ill|Heian period|Q193292|qid=Q193292}} it came to be called Sōsha Ōmiya Sansho Daimyōjin and served as the general tutelary shrine of the district. The same region also had the Shikinaisha Kutami Shrine, which is considered to have become a branch shrine of Ōmiya in the medieval period{{Sfn|Japanese Gods: Shrines and Sacred Places|p=32}}.

=== Cultural properties ===
{{ill|Magatama|Q334232|qid=Q334232}}, {{ill|Kudatama|Q11603258|qid=Q11603258}}, and whetstones used in their production - thought to have been made in Inbe Kamube - are dedicated at the shrine. In Shōwa 39 ({{ill|1964|Q2652|qid=Q2652}}), these were designated tangible cultural properties by Matsue as “Ancient relics related to bead production”<ref>{{Cite web|和書|url=http://www.city.matsue.shimane.jp/jumin/shisei/kouhou/kouhou_matsue/1508/1508d.htm|title=Kōhō Matsue No.625: Series Everyone’s Cultural Properties (4)|publisher={{ill|Matsue|Q207321|qid=Q207321}}|date=2003-08|url-status=dead|url-status-date=2017-10|archiveurl=https://archive.fo/20120722123029/http://www.city.matsue.shimane.jp/jumin/shisei/kouhou/kouhou_matsue/1508/1508d.htm|archivedate=2012-07-22}}</ref>.
